name: Create with Code - Unit 5 w/++Bonus Features
author: sambasnet
description: I try to work on UI as much as possible. All bonus features recreate with some own experiments. Swiping add trail with particle system. Scene loading with different scene and make choice for player which version like to play. Add time limit to win the game. Volume slider added on options and paused menu. Pause menu can use with Escape button. Use some of coding from prototype 3 and prototype 2 for revision purpose. Such as slider for heath and intro in start scene. Hope you will enjoy playing this game.
